name: CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2026
information: This competition **only** has the **3x3x3 Fewest Moves** event. For a competition experience more suitable for first-time competitors and competitors interested in regular speedsolving events, please check out **[CubingUSA Southeast Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastChampionship2026)**. The top 3 competitors at this FMC championship will be recognized during the award ceremony at Southeast Championship 2026. This competition will take place at multiple locations across the Southeast; check out the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026#70503-locations) for more details, including the separate competitor limits for each location. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTU3NzY3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4296f4d261136a2852f89153ffb9a717c8e8ddf9/SEC%2026%20Simplified%20PNG.png) This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SoutheastFMCChampionship2026#70504-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.
